data.narrative:
Trilobio is a seed-stage biotech company founded by Roya Amini-Naieni and Maximilian Schommer that has raised $11M to date. The valuation universe consists of 3 public comparables in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals, though no single peer cohort was sufficiently granular for direct median benchmarking.

The stage-progression method proved the only applicable triangulation approach. Using the $11M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical for seed-to-next-stage step-ups yields an implied valuation of $28M. Public comparables in the sector trade at a median 8.1x price-to-sales, but this anchor cannot be applied without the target's revenue, which remains undisclosed. The peer-median method was excluded due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum sample thresholds.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $23M to $32M, with a median point of $28M. The narrow evidence base—relying on a single methodological leg—introduces material uncertainty around terminal valuation. Key unknowns include the company's current revenue run-rate (necessary to anchor public comparables) and specific financial trajectories of the identified private peer set. Further diligence on unit economics and clinical pipeline milestones would strengthen conviction in final pricing.
